channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Lebanese who fled the Israeli invasion visit to see what's left
item.description: Residents of Nabatiyeh, an ancient town in southern Lebanon, have faced wars before, but the latest conflict with Israel is pushing them to their limits.

item.title: FDA weighs a new kind of flu shot based on technology RFK Jr. has questioned
item.description: The FDA is set to decide on Moderna's mRNA-based flu shot, potentially the first of its kind. The decision may spark debate, as the technology has been questioned by RFK Jr.

item.title: Opinion: Remembering Margo Howard
item.description: Margo Howard, known for her advice column "Dear Prudence" at Slate, passed away this week at age 86. She drew on her rich life experience to guide readers for years.

item.title: Slum residents move from tin shacks to new apartments in award-winning project
item.description: A pioneering initiative lets residents of a crowded slum help design their own housing, transforming their lives from one-room shacks to modern apartments.
